entries.description: Authentication-Results names SPF and DMARC as rspamd judged them, beside exim's iprev and DKIM, so a mail client shows spf=pass. One header, not two; without rspamd, or where a mail is not scanned, exim's own line stays as it was. Patched into a file the operator may have edited

A MySQL grant names its database exactly: _ and % in the name were wildcards, so a customer whose name starts another database's name (mys for mysql) got rights on it. Every grant of a database in a record is replaced by the exact one, a suspended database only loses the old grant

nginx answers without TLS 0-RTT: with ssl_early_data on, nginx 1.21.4 to 1.31.9 can be made to burn CPU (CVE-2026-132779), the OS packages of all four targets among them. 0-RTT saved one round trip on a resumed connection. Where the line was changed by hand it stays, and the update says so

Mail sent with SMTP AUTH and an empty envelope sender (read receipts, delivery reports) goes through the domain's relay, from the domain's outgoing address and with its relay exceptions, as the same mail with a sender does. A bounce stays as it was. Patched into a file the operator may have edited
